title: add-prefix-warmup-traces-and-prompt-shape-tail-latency-panel
author: Maya Chen
commits: b7f4e2a - instrument: add prefix_warmup annotated spans and sampling tag
d1c9a11 - metrics: add histogram for prefix_warmup_duration_ms and prompt_shape_key label
a90f3b2 - dashboard: add prompt-shape tail-latency panel and heatmap
c47b6d0 - rules: tune SLO alerting to ignore transient warmup spikes
e11a5f4 - docs: observability guide for prefix warmup traces and interpreting panel
description:
Motivation: We've seen recurring short-lived tail-latency spikes on cold prefix/cache misses and during client-driven prompt shapes (very long system prompts or unusual instruction formatting). These spikes generate noisy SLO alerts and obscure genuine regressions. This change introduces explicit 'prefix_warmup' annotated spans, a small histogram metric keyed by prompt_shape (a lightweight fingerprint of prompt structure), and a dashboard panel to visualize tail-latency by prompt_shape and warmup state.

What this PR does: - Adds span annotations for prefix warmup start/finish and tags spans with a boolean warmup=true/false and a lightweight prompt_shape key. - Emits prefix_warmup_duration_ms histogram and increments a warmup_miss counter so we can correlate cost and latency. - Adds a Prompt Shape Tail Latency dashboard (heatmap + percentile ridgeline) to help SREs and ML infra teams identify prompt shapes that cause persistent tails. - Introduces an alert tuning rule that dampens SLO alerts when the signal originates from warmup-only spans and requires persistence across N windows before firing. - Adds docs with guidance on interpreting the panel and recommended mitigations (prefetch, batching, model variant).

Checklist:
- [x] Instrument spans and metrics
- [x] Add dashboard JSON and snapshot
- [x] Add alert tuning and unit tests for rule logic
- [x] Add integration test for warmup span emission
- [x] Docs for oncall and SRE

Related: ENG-3241 (reduce warmup alert noise), SUP-812 (customer report of tail latency on long prompts). This is intentionally conservative: warmup spans are low-cardinality (prompt_shape is compact hashed string) and sampling is configurable via the existing telemetry sampler.

Notes on rollout: feature flag telemetry.prefix_warmup.enabled defaults to false in production; enabled in staging for 24h before opt-in on main. Metric cardinality guard added to prefix_warmup_metrics.go to cap new label counts to 200 per tenant.
